response.original_title: The Quest For The Lost Paintings Of Siberia
response.overview: Jesse Collver and Jack Gunter bring you the adventure of a lifetime in this no holds barred true life caper into the wilds of the Mongolian Border to rescue seventeen paintings--trapped behind the Iron Curtain for a quarter of a century. With time running out on an eleven day window, Jack must first find all of his work and negotiate the pile of red tape that has trapped the art in the basement of a Stalin-era museum. Meanwhile, at an impromptu museum opening, he reaches out to the Russian people on national TV with a message of peace, while leading the nation to participate in a Seattle Seahawks twelvth man cheer.
